facts.text: Solage is in Calistoga, at the quieter end of Napa Valley.
facts.excerpt: Calistoga is Napa’s quieter end. It’s walkable, slightly scruffier, and less scene-driven than Yountville or downtown Napa

facts.text: The property is laid out like a series of modern farmhouse neighborhoods with low whitewashed buildings and gravel paths.
facts.excerpt: The property unfolds like a series of modern farmhouse neighborhoods: low-slung, whitewashed buildings, gravel paths, and landscaping that feels mature and slightly wild rather than overly manicured.

facts.text: Accommodation is built around standalone cottages.
facts.excerpt: Everything here is built around standalone cottages, which immediately sets it apart.

facts.text: Even the entry-level studios have their own patio.
facts.excerpt: Even entry-level studios feel incredibly private, each with its own patio.

facts.text: Many rooms include outdoor showers, fire pits and garden space.
facts.excerpt: Many rooms include outdoor showers, fire pits, and generous garden space, making it easy to spend as much time outside as in.

facts.text: Spa Solage's Bathhouse is fed by Calistoga's geothermal springs and has hydrotherapy pools, a steam room, a sauna and a cold plunge.
facts.excerpt: The Bathhouse, fed by Calistoga’s geothermal springs, is the highlight, with multiple hydrotherapy pools, a steam room, sauna, and cold plunge.

facts.text: Solbar is the main restaurant, with a seasonal, locally driven menu.
facts.excerpt: Solbar is the anchor of the dining scene here, and true to Napa, it’s seasonal, locally driven, and consistently strong, especially for dinner.

facts.text: Picobar is a poolside restaurant serving modern Mexican food with tostadas, tacos and mezcal cocktails.
facts.excerpt: Set poolside, it leans into modern Mexican flavors with a Napa twist—tostadas, tacos, and mezcal-heavy cocktails are far more compelling than typical resort fare.

facts.text: The resort had a resort-wide redesign announced in May 2021.
facts.excerpt: Solage, Auberge Collection Rewrites Napa Valley Luxury With Vibrant, Resort-Wide Redesign

facts.text: Solage received the Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star Award in February 2020.
facts.excerpt: Solage, Auberge Collection Receives Forbes Travel Guide's Five-Star Award

facts.text: The mostly single-story, spread-out design makes navigation relatively straightforward, and accessible accommodations are available upon request.
facts.excerpt: The spread-out, mostly single-story design makes navigation relatively straightforward, and accessible accommodations are available upon request.

facts.text: The pool is lively and not particularly quiet.
facts.excerpt: It’s lively, well-serviced, and beautifully set, but not particularly quiet.

facts.text: Minibars are fully stocked but all items are chargeable.
facts.excerpt: Minibars are fully stocked but entirely chargeable

facts.text: Check-in delays have been known to happen at arrival.
facts.excerpt: particularly at arrival, where check-in delays have been known to happen
